blurb: Guests can enjoy narrated sightseeing cruises showcasing the natural beauty, history, and landmarks of the Thousand Islands region. Offerings include scenic river cruises, castle tours, sunset cruises, specialty excursions, and private charters for special events. The company has been family-owned since 1926 and provides experiences for all types of travelers.
